masters.name: site
masters.label: Site
masters.description: A generating plant: its location, grid connection and design capacity.

masters.name: party
masters.label: Party
masters.description: An organisation the business deals with: manufacturer, supplier, service provider, offtaker or software vendor. Names in the workbook are free text; one party per distinct name.

masters.name: party_role
masters.label: Party role
masters.description: The roles a party plays (OEM, supplier, service provider, offtaker, software vendor).

masters.name: equipment_model
masters.label: Equipment model
masters.description: A manufacturer's product model. Ends the model_id collision: product models live here, forecasting models in ml_model.

masters.name: asset
masters.label: Asset
masters.description: Every physical thing in one hierarchy (site → asset → component). Class-specific attributes live in 1:1 extensions.

masters.name: asset_inverter
masters.label: Inverter configuration
masters.description: Inverter design data, one row per inverter asset.

masters.name: asset_bess
masters.label: BESS configuration
masters.description: One battery storage system: design, specification, operating limits, maintenance intervals, safety and controls, formerly six 1:1 sheets.

columns.name: aux_hvac_k_w_per_container_per_10_c
columns.label: Aux HVAC kW per Container per 10C

masters.name: pv_array
masters.label: PV array
masters.description: A PV array tracked for sustainability (module counts for end-of-life planning), linked to its asset.

masters.name: pv_module_group
masters.label: PV module group
masters.description: A block of PV modules installed together, linked to the PV array asset that holds it.

masters.name: pv_population_segment
masters.label: PV population segment
masters.description: Modules of one model and batch within a group, with their opening balance.

masters.name: pv_module
masters.label: PV module
masters.description: A serialised PV module in its population segment.

masters.name: part
masters.label: Part
masters.description: One part master: the maintenance-spares master, the second spare-parts list and the planning materials (after C11/C12) merge on part code.

masters.name: part_stock
masters.label: Part stock
masters.description: Stock of one part at one site: the ERP/WMS snapshot with its reorder policy, plus the 30-day movement balance where the inventory ledger has one.

masters.name: rate_card
masters.label: Rate
masters.description: Every priced component (labour, equipment, vehicles, services, site mobilisation, part logistics) and every modelled rate or factor, one row each, with unit, currency and validity.

masters.name: crew
masters.label: Crew
masters.description: A maintenance crew and its working-time rules; its rates are on the rate card.

masters.name: technician
masters.label: Technician
masters.description: A technician: crew, home site, skill and working-time rules; pay rates are on the rate card.

masters.name: resource
masters.label: Planning resource
masters.description: A schedulable resource (technician, tool or vehicle) as the planner sees it.

masters.name: vehicle
masters.label: Vehicle
masters.description: A fleet vehicle and its home site (or the regional pool).

masters.name: tool
masters.label: Tool
masters.description: A specialist tool with its calibration state.

masters.name: system
masters.label: System
masters.description: An enterprise system in the landscape (EAM, WFM, fleet, SCADA…).

masters.name: connector
masters.label: Connector
masters.description: A data feed into AIP, registered once (formerly the technology registry and the sustainability connector registry).

masters.name: interface
masters.label: Interface
masters.description: A governed data exchange between two systems.

masters.name: source_document
masters.label: Source document
masters.description: An external standard, regulation or evidence source cited by models and disclosures.

masters.name: metric
masters.label: ESG metric
masters.description: A sustainability metric with its definition, formula and unit.

masters.name: metric_framework_map
masters.label: Metric disclosure mapping
masters.description: Which disclosure in which reporting framework (BRSR, GRI, ISSB, CSRD) a metric serves.

masters.name: ml_model
masters.label: Analytical model
masters.description: A governed forecasting or predictive model: algorithm, training window, validation and approval. AIP's own engines register here too.

masters.name: warranty_contract
masters.label: Warranty
masters.description: A warranty on an asset or a model batch, from the warranty register and the BESS product and performance warranties.

columns.name: retention_pct_eol
columns.label: Guaranteed retention at end of life (%)

masters.name: offtake_contract
masters.label: Offtake contract
masters.description: A power-purchase or storage-capacity contract: counterparty, tariff, capacity, term and obligations. Settlement figures are transactions (phase 3).

masters.name: intervention
masters.label: Intervention
masters.description: One maintenance intervention register: the optimiser's register (with the C9 candidates) and the planning register merge on intervention ID; the PV module interventions exist only in the planning register.

masters.name: scenario
masters.label: Planning scenario
masters.description: One scenario register: the optimiser's portfolio scenarios and the planners' intervention-level simulations.

masters.name: scenario_intervention
masters.label: Scenario line
masters.description: An intervention as evaluated or proposed in a scenario: the optimiser's scores and ranks, and planners' proposed windows.

masters.name: hse_incident
masters.label: HSE incident
masters.description: A health, safety and environment incident in its own ID space, separated from the operational event log.
